claims.summary: Arabian Nights 1993-12-17, credited artist Susan Van Camp.

Old Man of the Sea is a 2/3 with a tap-activated control ability and an optional skip of its own untap. The chosen target's power must be at most two when the ability resolves; untapping Old Man or raising the captured creature's power beyond its own ends control. A Kird Ape with two power is a valid target for an Old Man with power two. A controller may skip untapping Old Man on their next untap step to keep the Ape; if Old Man untaps later or the Ape's power grows greater than two, control ends immediately.
